findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is now abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: The stub body was reduced to `pass`, but the class subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler`, which declares `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values` and (newly in this PR) `build_occurrence_and_event_data` as abstract. The class therefore remains abstract. `Detector.detector_handler` calls `group_type.detector_handler(self)`, which now raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class`. Previously the handler was concrete and returned `[]`. `process_detectors` does not guard this call, so any detector whose type resolves to `metric_alert_fire` would abort processing for the whole data packet. The handler needs concrete implementations of the abstract members, or a test should cover instantiation so this is caught.

findings.title: test_dedupe builds the expected occurrence with the wrong group key
findings.body: In `TestEvaluateGroupKeyValue.test_dedupe` the expected occurrence is built with `build_mock_occurrence_and_event(handler, "val1", ...)`, but `evaluate_group_key_value` is called with group key `"group_key"`. The mock occurrence's fingerprint is derived from the group key (`[f"{detector.id}:{group_key}"]`), so the expected `IssueOccurrence` has fingerprint `...:val1` while the actual one has `...:group_key`. The other tests in this file compare occurrences by value, so the first `assert ... == expected_result` fails. The expected occurrence should be built with `"group_key"`.

findings.title: evaluate docstring still says it returns a list
findings.body: The docstring of `StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate` says it 'returns a list of `DetectorEvaluationResult`', but the signature and implementation now return a dict keyed by group key. Subclass authors read this docstring as the contract, so it should describe the dict return value.

findings.title: Stale TODO says the handler will become stateful later
findings.body: The comment says this will be a stateful detector once that abstraction is built, but this same change makes `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` a `StatefulDetectorHandler` subclass. The TODO is now misleading and should be removed or reworded.
